intro.text: A poisonous plant of the Forests of Hell.

description.text: It brings on severe headaches, drowsiness, dizziness and a foggy head. Its faint taste is easily hidden in food or beer.

It must be ground into a paste. A full dose in a man's food or drink sends him straight to sleep; half a dose leaves him mostly unaffected for a while before he drops off, though lightly enough to be woken.
Silence has William Ann slip half doses into the beer of Chesterton Divide and his four men so that she can kill them as they sleep.
